findings: Dead `_pending`/`_onDecide` interface contract — `InvoicePanel` accepts `pending: PendingCard[]` and `onDecide` in its public signature but aliases them with underscore prefixes to signal they are unused. Any caller that passes real `onDecide` callbacks expecting them to fire will silently lose those decisions. Document the props as deprecated or narrow the type to `pendingCount: number` only, removing the callback entirely.
